## 1. What is S TOM'S Signatures Light Bill ERP (SBV1)?
S TOM'S Signatures Light Bill ERP (SBV1) is an ultra-fast, offline-first commercial desktop Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and billing software engineered for Indian businesses. Built natively with C# .NET 8 (WPF) and embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), it runs 100% locally on Windows 10 and Windows 11 with 0ms query latency, zero internet requirement, and zero cloud dependency.

### Core Philosophy
- **Help First, Not Just Sales:** Built to genuinely eliminate paperwork, fraud, manual calculation errors, and counter delays for business owners.
- **100% Offline-First:** Your data stays on your machine. Invoices, stock, ledgers, and bank accounts are never locked behind internet connectivity or external servers.
- **35-Day Unrestricted Free Trial:** Every feature is unlocked for 35 days with zero payment or credit card required.

---

## 2. Business Suitability Guide (Who is SBV1 Made For?)

### A. 🏭 Textile Weaving Mills & Karkhana Floor (Surat / Pan-India)
- **Pain Points Solved:** Manual loom registers, taka length mismatch, beam run-out guesswork, double-entry between factory floor and sales billing.
- **Key Modules in SBV1:**
  - **Live Loom Floor Monitoring Grid:** Real-time machine status tracking (Waterjet, Airjet, Rapier, Sulzer) with live state badges (Running, Idle, Stop, Maintenance).
  - **Warp Beam Register:** Tracks Beam Inward, Supplier Lot, Total Ends, Reed count, balance meters, and automated beam run-out forecasting.
  - **Taka Production Register & Roll Cutter:** 1-click taka cut from looms with auto-incrementing Lot Number & Taka Number, actual meters, weight in Kg, and average grams/meter (g/m) density.
  - **Floor-to-Sales Taka Picker Modal:** In Sales Invoicing, click `[ 📦 Pick Takas ]` to view all In-Stock rolls on the mill floor, tick rolls, and auto-populate billable meters and lot numbers into the invoice without re-typing. Once saved, rolls are automatically marked `Sold`.
  - **Multilingual Factory Guide:** Step-by-step interactive floor guide available in **Hinglish**, **Gujarati**, and **English**, along with an isolated **Practice Demo Sandbox**.

### B. 🏢 Multi-Company Business Owners (Sister Concerns & Branches)
- **Pain Points Solved:** Re-typing the same 2,000 fabrics or 500 customers across multiple firm databases, or unwanted cross-company catalog leakage.
- **Key Modules in SBV1:**
  - **Selective Multi-Company Master Sync Pool:** Select exactly which sister firms participate in catalog sync (e.g. 3 textile firms share fabrics & customer contacts), while independent firms (e.g. retail shop or personal enterprise) remain 100% private, isolated, and untouched.
  - **Zero Data Leakage Guarantee:** Stock quantities, sales invoices, purchase records, bank ledgers, and cash balances remain 100% air-gapped per company SQLite database.
  - **Zero-Flood New Firm Setup:** Creating a new company defaults to clean isolation unless explicitly opted into the sync pool.

### C. 📦 Wholesale Traders & Commission Agents
- **Pain Points Solved:** Broker brokerage calculations, loose vs case packaging, multi-party ledger tracking, challan delivery.
- **Key Modules in SBV1:**
  - **Broker Management:** Broker picker, customizable brokerage percentages per line item, brokerage summary reports.
  - **BOS Statutory E-Way Bill Engine:** Full statutory GST Rule 138 automation, 1-click NIC JSON export, embedded portal automation with WebView2, and multi-invoice batch dispatch.
  - **Universal Excel Bulk Import Engine:** Standardized `.xlsx` template import with 2-step verification preview and cryptographic signature validation.

### D. 🏪 Retail Stores, Marts & Supermarkets
- **Pain Points Solved:** Slow billing queues, barcode scanner integration, fast customer lookup, instant receipts.
- **Key Modules in SBV1:**
  - **High-Speed Counter Billing:** Full keyboard shortcut bindings (Ctrl+P party picker, Ctrl+N new creation, Ctrl+E inline edit).
  - **80mm & 58mm Thermal Receipt Printing:** Native ESC/POS blit printing with auto-cutter support and bilingual regional font rendering.
  - **Barcode Scanning & Catalog Studio:** Instant barcode search, automated product catalog PDF generator with product images and wholesale/retail rates.

### E. 🍽️ Restaurants & Cafes
- **Key Modules in SBV1:**
  - **Table Floor Management:** Visual interactive table tiles (🟢 Available, 🔴 Occupied, 🟡 Cleaning).
  - **Zero-Trust LAN KDS (Kitchen Display System):** Kestrel local Wi-Fi mesh connecting cashier terminals to kitchen screens with OTP pairing without internet.
  - **Multi-Round KOTs & 3-Way Split Payments:** Cash + UPI + Card split billing.

---

## 3. Technical Specifications
- **Operating System:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit architecture)
- **Framework:** .NET 8.0 (Windows Presentation Foundation - WPF, Native XAML)
- **Database Engine:** Embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and foreign key integrity
- **Security & Integrity:** PBKDF2 100k salted PIN authentication, Authenticode code-signed binary, non-destructive migration engine
- **Installer Package:** Standalone offline Windows Setup executable (`SIGNATURES-BILL-Setup.exe`)
- **Package SHA-256 Checksum:** `4FC18C3A47128EE77629DC1D813CFBCA9D15D9495DB208F2C76433838DB4B694`
